record.paper: When Maximum Stable Set can be solved in FPT time

dossier_meta.paper: When Maximum Stable Set can be solved in FPT time
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every connected graph $H$, Maximum Independent Set in $H$-free graphs is in $\mathsf{P}$ if and only if $H \in \{P_\ell\}_{\ell} \cup \{S_{i,j,k}\}_{i \leq j \leq k}$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The polynomial-time complexity of MIS in $H$-free graphs has been studied since the early 1980s. Alekseev showed that if $H$ is neither a path nor a subdivided claw then MIS is NP-complete on $H$-free graphs, motivating this conjecture about the full dichotomy. The authors note that an even stronger conjecture is postulated by Lozin [28].
